mood: Dark, cinematic, intimate — like a premium theater watching a film about justice. Human, direct, compassionate but confident.

background.description: Warm charcoal with a hint of burgundy. NOT pure black.

text.description: Warm white like fireplace light. Subdued for body text to maintain hierarchy.

accent.description: Deep rich brake-lights-in-fog red for urgency/CTAs. Warm amber gold for highlights and numbers.

headlines.style: bold, slightly condensed, commanding, HUGE. Break lines unexpectedly.
headlines.sizes: text-6xl sm:text-7xl lg:text-[10vw] leading-[0.9] tracking-tighter uppercase

body.style: clean, warm, readable with generous line-height.

numbers.sizes: text-7xl sm:text-8xl lg:text-[12vw] leading-none text-[#D4AF37] font-black

layouts.general: Asymmetrical, organic layouts. No perfect symmetry. Intentional imperfections. Generous whitespace (p-12, p-24).
layouts.hero: Full screen cinematic. Image overlay with heavy charcoal/burgundy gradient to ensure text contrast. Text should feel monumental.
layouts.grids: Use Bento Grid Mode A (Tetris Grid) with wide gaps and empty spaces to create visual tension. No standard 3-column Bootstrap grids.

motion.philosophy: Scroll animations like turning pages. Use Framer Motion for revealing text and images slowly as user scrolls.
motion.effects: Parallax on background images. Subtle fade-in-up for typography. No fast, bouncy, or playful animations. Keep it grounded, heavy, and cinematic.

sections.nav: Sticky glassmorphism header. bg-[#161314]/80 backdrop-blur-xl. Logo on left, Gold phone number and Red CTA on right.

hero.content: Headline: 'You Focus on Healing. We Focus on Winning.' Subhead: 'If you've been injured, you shouldn't fight alone. Free consultation. No fee unless we win.'
hero.cta: Dominant Red CTA: 'Get Your Free Case Review' + Gold prominent phone.

sections.we_handle_everything: Chaos vs calm narrative. List chaos (medical bills, insurance) vs calm (we fight for you). Asymmetric layout.
sections.real_results: Big gold numbers with human stories (e.g., '$5.2M for a single mother who couldn't work after her crash'). No generic cards, use raw text + grid.
sections.what_actually_happens: 3-stage emotional journey timeline: 'The Call' -> 'The Fight' -> 'The Win'. Vertical line with glowing nodes.
sections.you_are_not_alone: Raw emotional testimonials. Use the dark silhouette image as a backdrop.
sections.final_push: Headline: 'Don't Let Them Run Out the Clock.' Same Red CTA + Warm phone line.
sections.footer: Dignified, large typography for phone, minimal links, small disclaimer. Darker background.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped or sharp rectangular with rich red background. No standard blue. Hover states should deepen the red. Add subtle glow to primary CTA.
components.cards: Avoid identical card grids. If using containers, use 1px border of white/10 with subtle radial gradients for depth, no generic white cards.
components.forms: Frontend only. Clean inputs with border-b only or dark filled inputs. On submit, replace with a warm confirmation message.

images.description: Time lapse photography of highway with red tail lights. Add a heavy gradient overlay: from-[#161314]/90 via-[#161314]/70 to-[#161314]
People standing in the dark. Deep moody silhouette.

media.icons: Use Phosphor Icons (Duotone) or Lucide React. Avoid generic gavel/scale/handshake. Use abstract or emotional icons (e.g., shield, heart, path).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text meets APCA/WCAG standards against the dark base. Use text-shadow on hero text if needed.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs) MUST include data-testid attribute.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use transparent backgrounds in headers or dropdowns. Always use solid or glassmorphism (bg-color + backdrop-blur).
Avoid centered text alignments except in specific constrained blocks. Left-align most text for better reading flow.
Use 2-3x more spacing than typical. p-12, p-24, gap-16.
Avoid generic 'AI slop' aesthetics. No uniform grids. Use layered designs, z-index hierarchy, and asymmetrical spacing.
Never use pure black #000000. Use the defined warm charcoal #161314.
Install and use framer-motion for scroll reveal effects.
Install and use lucide-react for icons.
DO NOT use generic icons like scales of justice or gavels.
instructions_to_main_agent: Read this JSON fully. Build the landing page in a single file or a structured component setup. Ensure all text and images are exactly as specified. The design should feel expensive, raw, and empathetic. Focus heavily on massive typography for headlines and numbers.
